description: ShelfMate: a reading tracker (no login) where six features work; the CSV export and the reading goal's progress bar do not do what they promise.

claims.text: Add a book with a title and an author and it appears on the shelf
Search the shelf by title or author and the list narrows to the matching books
Edit a book's title or author, or delete the book
Mark a book as Want to read, Reading or Finished and its badge changes
Rate finished books from 1 to 5 stars and see the average rating
Filter the shelf by status with the All, Want to read, Reading and Finished tabs
Export the shelf as a CSV file
Set a yearly reading goal and a progress bar shows how many books are finished
